Aipas C1 Xpress Urban Commuter E-Bike Overview
The Aipas C1 Xpress Urban Commuter E-Bike is built for riders who want the perfect balance of power, comfort, and city-smart design. Whether you’re gliding through downtown streets, running daily errands, or commuting to work, the C1 delivers smooth acceleration, efficient energy use, and exceptional comfort in every ride.
Key Features
1. Powerful and Efficient Motor

Gradient Capability: Effortlessly handles inclines up to 20°, ideal for city hills and bridges. For maximum performance and smoother throttle response, pair with the Brushless Motor Controller.

Charging Time: Fully recharges in 4–6 hours, ensuring minimal downtime.

3. Smooth Ride with Adjustable Suspension

Tires: 26 × 2.0 thin tires for nimble, agile city handling Enjoy a stable and cushioned ride even on uneven roads. Combine with the Suspension Seatpost for extra comfort on long commutes.

4. Safety and Visibility

Lighting: Integrated brake and tail lights for enhanced safety during day or night rides

Build: Lightweight 57 lbs frame supports up to 400 lbs load capacity Boost visibility with the Lighted Cycling Helmet for additional protection and style.

Transmission: Shimano 7-speed gears allow flexible and smooth performance in traffic or open stretches.

Ergonomics: Comfortable saddle and upright posture minimize fatigue on longer rides.

7. Urban Commuting Focus
Perfectly designed for daily commutes, errands, and leisure rides, the C1 XpressST balances power with portability, offering a dependable ride through any city landscape.
8. Multiple Riding Modes

Modes: Cruise Control | Assist Mode | Sport Mode | Pedal Assist | Pure Electric

Gears: Shimano 7-speed system provides a customizable and responsive riding experience.

Finish: Each color features a sleek, durable luster for modern urban appeal.

User-Friendly: Quick setup process makes it easy for new riders to get started fast.

Summary
The Aipas Xpress C1 Urban Commuter E-Bike offers a powerful yet refined ride for city commuters. With an 1100W peak motor, 90 Nm torque, and 62-mile range, it’s designed to handle urban terrain with agility and ease. The adjustable suspension, step-through frame, and lightweight 57 lb build make it ideal for riders of all skill levels and heights.
Combine the C1 with accessories like the Phone Mount and Bike Lock for a smarter, safer, and more convenient urban cycling experience.
